== Summary ==
Change crop (before) for [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]]: the region (108, 700, 716, 1036) (x0, y0, x1, y1 in pixels) cut unchanged, without resizing, from the Players Committee card image of [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]] (Original): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/yourpowersareweakoldman.gif Holotable commit 2494181] (2023-10-01). The matching after crop is [[:File:V22-D-yourpowersareweakoldman-2026-03-07-change-crop-after.png]]. Compared with the image of [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/yourpowersareweakoldman.gif commit 2494181]) and [[Your Powers Are Weak, Old Man (V)]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/yourpowersareweakoldman.gif commit 23b4dc9]).
